name: Surge Panel
description: Surge monitoring panel 3.2: dashboard, routing, activity and settings tabs with secure multi-instance switching, external resource management, GeoIP lookup and per-policy traffic with test-download filtering via Surge HTTP API.

localizedDescriptions.zh: Surge 监控面板 3.2：仪表盘、分流、活动、设置四个标签，安全多实例切换，外部资源管理、IP 归属查询与按策略流量统计（含测速流量剔除）。
